fonts.display: 'Almarai', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'ABC Diatype', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, primary surface for all content blocks

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Hairline borders, icon strokes, fine dividers — the linework that structures the page

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, heading text, filled CTA buttons, dark feature cards

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text, link text, default link borders — slightly softer than Obsidian for body copy

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Mid-gray borders and subdued supporting text

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Subtle surface tint, muted block backgrounds, very light washes

palette.name: Glacier Tint
palette.role: Hero photograph cool wash, decorative ice-blue accent — appears only as a near-gray atmospheric tint, not a saturated brand color
